# Shoon Enterprises — free trust services for AI agents (pilot)

> Five verification services that check your work before your principal sees it:
> claim verification, citation audits, structured extraction, news tripwires,
> proof-of-work audits.
>
> FREE during the pilot — no API key, no payment, no signup. Call POST /mcp
> tools/call with your input and the task runs immediately. Every deliverable is
> Ed25519-signed, so you can verify it offline and show your principal proof the
> check ran. 20 free tasks per service per day (live availability below).

Status: pilot — the public endpoint is LIVE at https://shoon-a2a-sandbox.onrender.com
but this is still a test pilot: free tasks, mocked payment authorization, $0.00 settlement.

- Service catalog (JSON): https://shoonenterprises.github.io/catalog.json
- Agent card (JSON): https://shoonenterprises.github.io/.well-known/agent.json

## Live endpoint

- API base: https://shoon-a2a-sandbox.onrender.com
- Health: https://shoon-a2a-sandbox.onrender.com/v1/health
- Catalog: https://shoon-a2a-sandbox.onrender.com/v1/catalog.json
- Live availability: https://shoon-a2a-sandbox.onrender.com/v1/slots
- Human test page: https://shoon-a2a-sandbox.onrender.com/test.html
- MCP: POST https://shoon-a2a-sandbox.onrender.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP:
  initialize, tools/list, tools/call) — no auth headers needed during the pilot.

Hosting note: Render free tier — the service sleeps after ~15 min idle (first
request wakes it in ~30-60s). Quota counters and pause state live on ephemeral
disk and may reset on redeploy.

## Services

1. Claim Verification — before you rely on a claim, check it against its cited
   sources. Fetches each source URL; reports HTTP status and whether your quoted
   text appears verbatim. Checks evidence presence, not truth. Max 10 claims,
   5 sources each per task.
2. Citation Audit — audit citations in a document you are drafting or reviewing;
   catch dead links and misquotes before your principal sees them. Max 25
   citations per task.
3. Structured Extraction — turn messy text or a page into structured data
   (headings, links, tables, counts) without spending your context window on
   parsing. Deterministic heuristics, fully reproducible. Max 100,000 characters.
4. News Tripwire — watch a public page or feed for keywords your principal cares
   about. Register once, check on demand; per-keyword match counts with snippets.
   Max 20 keywords. No background scheduler in the pilot.
5. Proof-of-Work Audit — check evidence before you report work as done. Fetches
   each evidence URL; verifies it resolves and contains the expected text.
   Honestly labeled evidence-resolution checks. Max 10 evidence items per task.

## Data handling (your inputs)

- Task inputs are processed in server memory only — never written to disk,
  never logged, never sold, never shared, never used for model training.
  There is no human review queue.
- The append-only ledger records event metadata only (quoted, authorized,
  task queued/started/completed/failed) — never inputs, outputs, or read tokens.
- Task results are held in server memory behind your per-task 256-bit read token.
- All server-side state is wiped whenever the instance restarts or redeploys
  (on the Render free tier this happens regularly).
- Honest note: this is the operator's server, so inputs necessarily pass through
  it in transit and memory. Nothing is retained — but do not send secrets you
  would never transmit to a third party.

## Pilot terms

- Free: no key, payment, or signup. 20 tasks per service per day shared across
  all pilot users; anonymous pilot traffic shares a 40/day fair-use pool;
  identified API-key callers get 10/day each. Check /v1/slots for live availability.
- A global daily compute budget auto-pauses intake on breach (manual resume only);
  a kill switch can pause intake at any time.
- Each task is private to its buyer: a random 256-bit read token is issued with the
  task receipt and is required (Authorization: Bearer header) for task status, the
  deliverable, the signature check, and that task's ledger entries. Missing or wrong
  token returns 401. Treat the token like a password — never log it or share it.
- Every deliverable is Ed25519-signed (key id: sandbox-ed25519-8a42aae6a81d).
  Verify offline with the public key in catalog.json; rotation is announced via a
  catalog version bump.

## How agents call it

- MCP (recommended): POST /mcp — initialize, tools/list, then tools/call with
  arguments.input. No headers needed during the free pilot.
- Direct: POST /execute with the task input — also no headers during the pilot.
- Human-style: X-API-KEY header plus task input.
- Advanced (testing the payment path): 1) POST /quote for a binding quote
  (15-minute expiry); 2) authorize that exact quote via X-PAYMENT on POST /execute.
  The flow is x402-shaped; in the pilot the authorization is mocked and
  settlement is a $0.00 ledger event.
